"TEMPO TUESDAY"
Day: 8 Tuesday 10-08-24

Warm Up: Get Loose and memorize
the rep tempo.

The Rep Tempo of the Day!!
5 seconds on the way Down
2 second pause in the Bottom
Normal tempo on the way up

1. BACK SQUAT 4 sets of 4 reps @ 60%
* 2 min rest between sets

2. FRONT SQUAT 3 sets of 4 reps @ 45%
% taken from Back Squat Max, 2 min rest

3. DB Bulgarian Split Squats
3 sets of 5 reps each leg
2 min rest between sets

Cardio
BB RDL's
3 sets of 5 reps
90 sec rest between sets

Recovery
All you can
eat tacos.
8-4 hrs sleep
30 min walk

"Day 8: Tempo Tuesday"
Warm up: Get Loose and memorize the rep tempo. The Rep Tempo of the Day!! 5 seconds on the way Down, 2 second pause in the Bottom, Normal tempo on the way up
1. Back Squat 4 sets of 4 reps @ 60%
rest 2:00
2. Front Squat 3 sets of 4 reps @ 45% of back squat max
rest 2:00
3. DB Bulgarian Split Squats 3 sets of 5 reps
* each leg
rest 2:00
4. BB RDL's 3 sets of 5 reps
rest 1:30
Recovery: All you can eat tacos. · 8-4 hrs sleep · 30 min walk
